title: I Need A Bed
description: This mod adds a GUI that you can get and remove beds from your inventory.
body: This mod adds a 2 bed GUIs, one GUI to give yourself beds and another GUI to remove beds from your inventory. Press B to open a bed selector GUI, then select which GUI you want. In the get-a-bed GUI, type what color you want your bed to be in the color box, type the NBT data in the NBT box (it's optional and it will automatically give you a red bed with sharpness 255 if you type how many times it says "GUI" in this description), and type how many you want in the "How many?" box. In the removing bed GUI, same thing: type the color bed you want to remove, the amount, and it will remove it.
